### Self-review checklist

- [ ] All intended changes are in this PR, and nothing unrelated
- [ ] I can explain every line of the diff
- [ ] `make test` and `make test-race` pass
- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by a test; a bug fix has a
      regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Public API changes are documented — doc comments, `README.md`, and an
      `ExampleXxx` where useful
- [ ] User-visible changes have a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Commit messages follow the format in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] No references to non-public resources — internal URLs, hosts, trackers
